description: [provider] List world regions. Returns all regions (CompanyEnrich · Company data) (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

inputSchema.description: FREE, no parameters. Returns hierarchical region ids ('Africa', 'Africa/Eastern Africa') each with the ISO country codes it contains — these ids are what the `regions` filter on company search accepts, and the embedded country lists let you expand a region into `countries` yourself.

name: companyenrich_geo_regions
